This guide describes the most effective methods to train the Fletching skill for members. It mostly focuses on the creation of bows and ammunition, as that is the most common method of training the skill. The experience rate estimates in this guide do not incorporate the use of any experience boosting items or bonus experience. Boosting your experience, for example by having bonus experience, wearing all or part of the fletcher's outfit, fletching cape, or using a portable fletcher, will increase the experience gained for each action and reduce the overall cost of training Fletching.

Rates given in this guide are a maximum amount possible; they assume that you will be fletching steadily, with quick banking and few to no distractions in game or in real life. Many players will, realistically, not achieve these amounts.

To significantly speed up the banking process, it is recommended that players use bank presets. This is especially important if stringing bows, as it will only take one click to swap the bows in your inventory with 14 unstrung bows and 14 bowstrings. Set up the preset to include whichever materials you are going to use and craft your items. Right-click on the bank chest or banker and select "load last preset from ...". This allows you to bank all your items and replace them with your preset without having to go into the bank interface. All calculations in this guide are rounded up; this may result in you needing slightly fewer materials than stated.

• The proto-tool reward from Stealing Creation can potentially be a useful item for level 40 Fletching, as its knife form can be drained to gain 20k bonus experience in fletching. However, the time taken to obtain one must be balanced against its usefulness; combat games are twenty minutes long, and non-combat clan games are typically 10–15 minutes long, which is time you may prefer to spend fletching instead.
  • Grand Exchange prices are the median price. Materials may cost more than the prices stated, and finished products may sell for less.
  • Many finished ammunition items (such as dragon arrows, rune arrows, and rune darts) should be sold to a general store instead of the Grand Exchange if the store buys for more than it is possible to sell for on the GE. Moreover, stores buy essentially unlimited ammunition (up to a max cash stack worth) immediately. Broad arrows are an exception because they are untradeable. The main options are to keep them as a collection or disassemble them.
  • Fletching an inventory of unstrung bows from logs takes 50 seconds an inventory. Stringing an inventory of 14 bows to make the finished product takes 15 seconds. These have been rounded up to 60 seconds and 20 seconds respectively to account for banking time.
  • Fletching a bow from a log and stringing that same bow gives the same experience. With this in mind, the number of logs and bowstrings should be halved if you decide to both fletch and string.
  • A calculator that shows the costs of making bows and ammunition can be found here: Calculator:Fletching/Items.
  • Portable fletchers are commonly used at the Grand Exchange and at Fort Forinthry, in the Ranger's Workroom, on World 84.
  • A Brooch of the Gods may be used to further extend the bonus effects from portable fletchers.

In order to maximise efficiency, have an eternal magic wood box and a stack of noted eternal magic logs in the backpack. You can fill the wood box with the noted logs to quickly restock without needing to use a bank. Using a wood box is mandatory for the Mk. 5 upgrade since it requires 32 logs.

Tempered fungal shaft After completing the Extinction quest, players with at least level 82 Fletching can participate in the Zygomite Carestyling activity as part of 'Accidental' Fletching and Firemaking. There, players can style scruffy zygomites' cuticles for around 200,000 Fletching experience per hour. Carestyling zygomites is fairly laid-back and can generate a profit from the tempered fungal shafts gathered and occasional unchecked zygomites found while taking part in the activity.

The use of a crystal knife is recommended as it provides a 5% chance of double shafts and experience, and does not degrade when carestyling.

With at least 65 Fletching and 65 Woodcutting, players can start carving Fenmoor Totems. The activity scales up to 105 Fletching, and provides a cheap way to train Fletching, though a significant amount of time must be spent on chopping the wood required for the activity.

After the Exctinction quest, players may train Fletching at the Fletcher's hut in the Dream of Iaia. Working at this skilling station yield 350,000 base Fletching experience per hour. Up to 350,000 experience may be stored in the station before it must be recharged with wood from the Anachronia base camp.

Sagaie Another alternative is making Sagaie at the Jadinko lair at level 83 Fletching, although this also requires 83 Woodcutting and 83 Firemaking, and it can be a lot slower than making Dragon darts or arrows due to the time spent collecting supplies. However, it is completely free.
Bundling bamboo gives 100 experience per bundle, can be done with 2 golden bamboo or 5 bamboo obtained from the Arc region.

This article is about the Free-to-play guide. For the members' guide, see Pay-to-play Fletching training.

This article gives tips about training the Fletching skill in a free-to-play world. Fletching was made free-to-play on 9 October 2017.

Portable fletchers grant 10% more Fletching XP along with other various benefits.

• This guide focuses on the creation of bows, as that is the most common method of training the Fletching skill and therefore the materials are easiest to get hold of.
  • XP/hr rates given in this guide are a maximum amount possible; they assume that you will be fletching steadily, with quick banking and few to no distractions in game or in real life. Many players will, realistically, not achieve these amounts. To significantly speed up the banking process it is recommended that players use presets. This is especially important if stringing bows, as it will only take one click to swap the bows in your inventory with 14 unstrung bows and 14 bowstrings. Set up the preset to include whichever materials you are going to use and set it to either "1" or "2" for quick access. This quickly adds up and saves a lot of time.
  • Likewise, this guide assumes that you will be buying/gathering the materials for your Fletching before starting, rather than doing so as you go. Doing the latter will severely impact how much Fletching experience is gained per hour.
  • All calculations in this guide are rounded up; this may result in you needing slightly fewer materials than stated.
  • Grand Exchange prices are the median price. Materials may cost more than the prices stated, and finished products may sell for less.
  • Fletching an inventory of unstrung bows from logs takes 50 seconds an inventory. Stringing an inventory of 14 bows to make the finished product takes 15 seconds. These have been rounded up to 60 seconds and 20 seconds respectively to account for banking time.
  • Experience for fletching a bow from a log and stringing that same bow gives the same experience. With this in mind, the number of logs and bowstrings should be halved if you decide to both fletch and string.
  • A calculator that shows the costs of making bows and ammunition can be found here: Calculator:Fletching/Items.
